subject: Token and theme register
meaning: A compact precision token-and-theme register. A slim satin-steel source ribbon carries four groups of small code-like engraved bars. A single transverse adjustable registration comb aligns those groups with a removable palette cassette. Past the comb, the same groups appear in restrained oxide, dark graphite and muted sage enamels. The cassette, comb and two short alignment pins form one integrated refined instrument. This visualizes TextMate scopes being mapped through a theme into highlighted output. Use no glowing lights, rainbow prism, flame, forge, screen, giant gear or generic machine. The different token groups should be plainly visible as repeated aligned bar shapes.

Render as one believable fine-mechanical bench instrument. Satin brushed steel, warm graphite edge structure, one restrained rust-brown oxide component. Warm neutral highlights, soft studio daylight from upper left, physically restrained reflections. Refined, light, precise, durable and carefully machined; no violence, grunge, dirt, dramatic darkness or heavy industrial aesthetic. Keep the meaning readable through a few clear components and their physical relationship, rather than a dense accumulation of generic screws. Use only a few discreet real fasteners.
Composition: three-quarter orthographic-like view from slightly above, matching the existing family reference camera. Center the complete isolated object in a moderately wide landscape composition, with 8–12% clear margin around every edge and no clipping. Keep the whole object in focus. A faint local contact shadow is allowed as semi-transparent alpha; no opaque floor, background gradient, black matte, presentation board or text labels. No product wordmark, caption, watermark or interface. Genuine transparent background, including open spaces between components. Output only the original reusable graphic asset.
